interface.longDescription:
Find useful ideas and turn a chosen direction into a practical result. Bring a business challenge, engineering contradiction, research question, inefficient process, everyday problem or creative brief.

Idea Man identifies the outcome, evidence, constraints and current stage, then chooses useful thinking methods and specialist workflows. Explore reframing, inversion, subtraction, analogy, systems reasoning, first principles, contradiction resolution and experiments.

Eleven skills cover innovation strategy, research and writing, quality checks, scoped learning, briefing, variations, critique, concept development, execution handoff and optional local project continuity. Use supplied sources for research, preserve approved decisions during exact edits, and compare distinct approaches with clear tradeoffs.

Production uses tools available in your host. Optional Python helpers validate structured plans and local project records. Saving a project requires your authorization. Ideas and predictions remain hypotheses until evidence supports them; plans and prompts are distinguished from executed work.
